literal: Compassion wealth [is] wealth among wealth; material wealth base people with-even exist.
translation: The wealth of compassion is the true wealth among all wealth. Material wealth exists even with the base.
modern: அருளாகிய செல்வமே செல்வங்களில் சிறந்த செல்வமாகும். பொருளாகிய செல்வம் இழிந்தவர்களிடத்திலும் இருக்கும்.
explanation: The couplet contrasts two types of wealth: the wealth of compassion and material wealth. It declares that compassion is the ultimate wealth among all forms of wealth. This is because material wealth is common and can be found even among base or low-minded people. The word 'கண்ணும்' (even at the place of) emphasizes that possessing material goods does not indicate a person's true worth. Therefore, true value lies only in cultivating a compassionate heart.
